articleTitle: Four-switch Buck-Boost converter based on model predictive control with graphical programming method
publicationTitle: Annual Meeting of CSEE Study Committee of HVDC and Power Electronics (HVDC 2023)
abstract: Due to the inherent advantages, including the ability of both voltage step-up and step-down, positive output voltage, and reduced number of passive components and voltage stress of the power devices, the four-switch Buck-Boost converter has been attracting people's attention. However, it encounters challenges in mode transfer within the multi-mode control strategy. Given the discrete operation and finite transfer state nature of power electronic converters, this paper employs model predictive control(MPC) to address mode transfer difficulty while offering numerous system-level benefits. Compared with the average inductor current control ,the effectiveness of the control strategy is verified in the simulation test. Furthermore, this paper introduces self-developed software, PECtrlStudio, which greatly streamlines the intricate development and debugging processes via graphical programming.

articleTitle: Research on overvoltage withstand level of ultra-high voltage submarine cable flexible joints
publicationTitle: Annual Meeting of CSEE Study Committee of HVDC and Power Electronics (HVDC 2023)
abstract: The continuous development of offshore wind power technology has made the application of high-voltage submarine cables more and more used. However, submarine cables are expensive to build and have serious consequences when they fail, so the requirements for safety and reliability are very high. The flexible joint is one of the weakest parts of the submarine cable system. Therefore, the overvoltage withstand level of the submarine cable flexible joint is an important evaluation basis for the reliability of the entire system. Based on the actual submarine cable system, this article establishes a simplified switching impulse voltage test circuit to verify the actual voltage withstand level of the 220-kV cross-linked polyethylene submarine cable flexible joint. The results show that XLPE submarine cables and flexible joints used in the test can at least withstand a switching impulse overvoltage with a peak of 950 kV. In addition, this article also summarizes some reasons for insulation breakdown failures in flexible joints and submarine cable bodies, and gives corresponding improvement suggestions.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of magnetically controlled oscillating DC circuit breaker controller based on FPGA
publicationTitle: Annual Meeting of CSEE Study Committee of HVDC and Power Electronics (HVDC 2023)
abstract: A single-core, multi-level, modular control method with FPGA as the core is proposed for the control and protection device of magnetically controlled oscillating DC circuit breakers. Firstly, the control circuit is built based on the control principle of magnetically controlled oscillating DC circuit breakers, and the control requirements and design scheme of the controller are analyzed. Secondly, we designed the control module with FPGA as the core, and realized the real-time orderly control of DC circuit breaker by fiber optic control unit according to the way of synchronous finite state machine, and realized the fault detection by analog and digital input to ensure the accuracy and safety under the high-speed control of DC circuit breaker. Finally, the controller prototype is developed and applied to magnetically controlled oscillating DC circuit breakers and further verified and analyzed by empirical evidence.

articleTitle: Transmission line multi feature data fusion based on depth self encoder
publicationTitle: Annual Meeting of CSEE Study Committee of HVDC and Power Electronics (HVDC 2023)
abstract: Faced with the problems of high energy consumption and incomplete data extraction in multi-feature data fusion, a multi-feature data fusion method based on depth autoencoder is proposed. A depth autoencoder is constructed to extract multi-feature data of transmission lines. To solve the problem of gradient disappearance, the extracted data is trained by layer-by-layer training method. The forward propagation method is used to calculate the confidence and judge the stability of the sensor cluster. The similarity between different features is calculated by using Babbitt coefficient, and the similarity weights between different data are obtained by weighted feature fusion to achieve weighted fusion of multi-feature data. LEACH protocol is used for clustering to avoid channel congestion and incomplete data extraction which may affect the fusion result. According to the experimental results, the maximum energy consumption of the method unit is 145kJ, which is less than the total energy consumption of data fusion, and the purpose of saving fusion energy loss can be achieved. The number of extracted cells is 100, consistent with the actual cells, which can achieve the purpose of accurate data extraction.

articleTitle: Strengthening communication security in power LAN based on situation awareness intelligent system
publicationTitle: Annual Meeting of CSEE Study Committee of HVDC and Power Electronics (HVDC 2023)
abstract: To strengthen the communication data carrying capacity of electric power local area networks and achieve a relatively stable connection form in the entire communication network, an intelligent perception system for communication security situations in electric power local area networks is designed. Based on the B/S framework system, the components within the electric power local area network are divided into layered forms, and external interfaces are utilized to establish connections between modules. On this basis, a server-side communication thread is established to obtain accurate data information parsing results through forwarding communication commands, complete the communication requirements analysis of the electric power local area network, combine relevant hardware structural layouts, and realize the application of the intelligent perception system for communication security situations in electric power local area networks. The results of the example analysis show that, compared to bus-controlled systems, under the influence of the intelligent perception system, the host of the electric power local area network can carry a greater amount of communication data in a unit of time, which has a certain promoting effect on maintaining the stable connection capability of the communication network.

articleTitle: Research on harmonic impedance characteristics of doubly-fed induction generator
publicationTitle: Annual Meeting of CSEE Study Committee of HVDC and Power Electronics (HVDC 2023)
abstract: The doubly-fed induction generator (DFIG) may exhibit negative resistance effects over a wide frequency band due to its control system, which introduces the risk of unstable oscillations to the interconnected system. The existing studies usually adopt the small-signal linearization method to establish the analytical harmonic impedance models of the DFIG, and the modeling processes are based on many assumptions. Therefore, these models are difficult to use for a comprehensive investigation of the harmonic impedance characteristics of the DFIG. In this paper, a detailed electromagnetic transient simulation model of the DFIG containing the wind turbine, the induction generator, the rotor-side converter and the grid-side converter is built, and its harmonic impedance model is established using the frequency sweep method. On this basis, the impacts of the wind speed, the control parameters of the rotor-side converter and the gird-side converter on the harmonic impedance characteristics are investigated. The results show that the DFIG's harmonic impedance exhibits equivalent negative resistance effects on the left side of the fundamental frequency and around the fundamental frequency, and the impedance's amplitude and phase in the negative resistance band on the left side of the fundamental frequency are influenced by the wind speed and some controller parameters.

articleTitle: Research and application of defect reconstruction method for ultra-high voltage composite insulators based on thermal imaging technology
publicationTitle: Annual Meeting of CSEE Study Committee of HVDC and Power Electronics (HVDC 2023)
abstract: Composite insulators, as one of the key equipment in power systems, may have various internal defects such as bubbles and cracks due to external environmental factors. These defects can potentially degrade the performance of insulators and even lead to accidents. Therefore, the detection and diagnosis of internal defects in composite insulators are crucial for ensuring the safe operation of power systems. This paper focuses on the research of defect reconstruction inside composite insulators and proposes a method based on thermal imaging technology, which is applied to practical engineering. By analyzing the thermal characteristics of composite insulators and combining advanced data processing and image reconstruction algorithms, defects inside the insulators can be effectively detected and localized, providing essential guidance for subsequent repair and maintenance work.

articleTitle: Research on insulation coordination of LCC-DC de-icing device
publicationTitle: Annual Meeting of CSEE Study Committee of HVDC and Power Electronics (HVDC 2023)
abstract: To solve the problem of insulation coordination design of LCC-DC de-icing device, this paper establishes PSCAD/EMTDC model of de-icing device and icing line, and obtains overvoltage distribution of de-icing device through simulation calculation and research of line induced voltage, ground fault, AC switching impulse and icing line disconnection, and selects arrester parameters and equipment insulation level of de-icing device. In addition, it is proposed to optimize the terminal connection mode of icing lines to reduce induced overvoltage of icing lines, and limit lightning intrusion overvoltage by installing gaps in de-icing tubes.

articleTitle: Research on ground wire ice melting technology of high-voltage transmission line
publicationTitle: Annual Meeting of CSEE Study Committee of HVDC and Power Electronics (HVDC 2023)
abstract: High-voltage line ice covering is not only related to the stable operation of the power grid, but also affects people's normal life and the operation of industrial and mining enterprises. At present, some exploration and research on the anti-ice melting technology of transmission lines have been carried out in foreign countries, and some research results have been applied to the process of transmission line melting, and the effect is also ideal after practice. However, due to the incomplete insulation of the overhead ground wire, when the ice is serious, the measures cannot be taken, resulting in the damage of the tower and the shutdown of the line. For this reason, the common ice melting methods are compared according to the ice melting mechanism. Three kinds of ground wire ice melting schemes are proposed, namely, ground wire series loop mode, ground wire parallel mode and long line section mode, to improve the overall ice melting capacity and range of high voltage transmission lines, and further improve the reliability of transmission lines.

articleTitle: Study on thermal sensing insulating composite coating material for online monitoring of energy storage power plants
publicationTitle: Annual Meeting of CSEE Study Committee of HVDC and Power Electronics (HVDC 2023)
abstract: Energy storage power plants can flexibly regulate the power needs of the grid and guarantee the stability of the development of new power systems. However, thermal failures caused by local overheating of battery cells, insensitive response of monitoring equipment, and other problems greatly threaten the safe operation of plants. Therefore, it is necessary to realize the real-time monitoring of the operational status of the energy storage power plants. Traditional online temperature detection means including infrared temperature measurement, thermocouple sensing, fiber optic sensing, etc. are easily constrained by many factors such as accuracy, environment, and cost. Therefore, this paper proposes a thermosensitive microcapsule prepared by in-situ polymerization doped into epoxy resin by gradient high-temperature method, so as to prepare a thermal sensing insulation composite coating material. It has the advantages of high sensitivity and high stability. Experiments show that the prepared composite coating material has reversible color changeability with temperature change, and the color changes significantly at 65 °C. When the microcapsule doping mass fraction is lower than 0.2%, the composite coating material maintains better electrical properties, providing a solution for online monitoring of thermal faults in energy storage power plants under complex working conditions.

articleTitle: A solution method of ill-conditioned matrix in electromagnetic transient simulation based on regularization algorithm
publicationTitle: Annual Meeting of CSEE Study Committee of HVDC and Power Electronics (HVDC 2023)
abstract: The electromagnetic transient simulation of power system is related to solving ill-conditioned matrix equations, which can not get satisfactory numerical results by the conventional method. In this paper, the regularization method is used to solve the ill-conditioned matrix equations in electromagnetic transient simulation. The numerical results show that the regularization method can solve the ill-conditioned matrix in electromagnetic transient simulation precisely.

articleTitle: A coordinated frequency control of LCC-HVDC for quasi-synchronous operation of asynchronously interconnected power systems
publicationTitle: Annual Meeting of CSEE Study Committee of HVDC and Power Electronics (HVDC 2023)
abstract: In this paper, a new coordinated control strategy for Line-Commutated Converter based High Voltage Direct Current (LCC-HVDC) system is proposed to support the frequency of both sending- and receiving-end power systems under large frequency disturbance. A frequency/DC voltage (f/V) droop controller and a PI-based DC current controller are proposed as the outer loops of the conventional inverter and rectifier controllers, respectively. Through the f/V droop controller, the DC voltage is used to transfer the receiving end (RE) AC system frequency information to the sending end (SE), so that station to station communication is not required. Then together with the PI-based DC current controller, quasi-synchronous operation of asynchronously interconnected systems is achieved. Thus, the sharing of frequency response between the sending- and receiving-end systems is realized. Moreover, to avoid the negative impacts of the proposed method on the fault recovery process, a modified voltage-dependent current-order limit (VDCOL) control is incorporated into the proposed frequency control. The effectiveness of the proposed method is demonstrated through case studies using a modified four-generator two-area (4G2A) power system.

articleTitle: Systematic intelligent analysis tools and practices for the management and control of power grid transmission channels under the background of big data
publicationTitle: Annual Meeting of CSEE Study Committee of HVDC and Power Electronics (HVDC 2023)
abstract: Liuzhou Bureau, an ultra-high-voltage transmission company of the South Network, is responsible for the construction, operation and maintenance management of the main network frame of West Power East in the central and northern Guangxi. The line channels are mostly mountain forests and forest farms, and tree barrier management is an important part of safe production. Traditional artificial tree barrier data analysis has problems such as massive data processing difficulties, long data analysis time, and prone to statistical errors and omissions. Relying on the intelligent analysis and control platform, this project realizes the intelligent and visual management of tree barrier data based on artificial intelligence technology, bids farewell to the traditional mode of manually checking data one by one, gets rid of manual intervention, realizes automatic comparison analysis and update of data, achieves the purpose of intuitive visualization of tree barrier, and solves the tree barrier The problem of data processing is of great significance for tree barrier data analysis and processing.

articleTitle: Optimization method for transformer maintenance considering node importance of power grid
publicationTitle: Annual Meeting of CSEE Study Committee of HVDC and Power Electronics (HVDC 2023)
abstract: In order to balance the maintenance resources and maintenance requirements, an optimal maintenance order method for power grid equipment from the perspective of the regional power grid is proposed in this paper. First of all, the condition assessment of power grid equipment is established based on the health index theory and hierarchical evaluation method. Then, the regional power grid topology model is obtained by complex network theory, and the node importance index is defined to represent the influence of equipment status on the power grid. Finally, the equipment status evaluation results are revised combined with the node importance, which can be used as the basis for maintenance order of regional power grid equipment. After all, the practicability and superiority of the method are demonstrated by the actual data of a regional power grid with 40 nodes.

articleTitle: Research on large-capacity medium-voltagedc fast-break technology
publicationTitle: Annual Meeting of CSEE Study Committee of HVDC and Power Electronics (HVDC 2023)
abstract: Safe, reliable, fast and environmentally friendly medium voltage DC disconnection technology is the key guarantee for safe operation and fault isolation of DC distribution systems. In this paper, a medium-voltage DC fast-break topology with low on-state loss, high reliability and large breaking capacity is proposed by combining high-speed mechanical switch and fuse, which realizes the integrated design of current transfer and breaking process. The optimal parameters of this topology scheme are determined by studying current transfer and breaking characteristics which including arc voltage, fuse internal resistance, stray inductance, current rise rate etc.. The topology scheme is verified to have the capability of breaking 30kA short-circuit current quickly and reliably within 1.5ms through simulation and experimental tests. The results show that the high-capacity medium-voltage DC fast-break topology proposed in this paper can effectively prevent the high-capacity short-circuit faults in DC distribution networks, which is of great significance to further ensure the safe and stable operation of DC distribution systems.

articleTitle: Fault analysis of reactor based on vibration signals
publicationTitle: Annual Meeting of CSEE Study Committee of HVDC and Power Electronics (HVDC 2023)
abstract: Vibration analysis method is a technique to diagnose equipment faults by measuring and analyzing frequency spectrum by installing vibration sensors on the surface of power equipment box, which is a powerful supplement to traditional power equipment monitoring methods. In this paper, the structural characteristics of the reactor are analyzed, and the vibration of the reactor in the offshore booster station is analyzed based on the vibration method, and the faults of the reactor are judged accurately, which fully proves the effectiveness of the vibration method in fault diagnosis.

articleTitle: Risk assessment and energized treatment of main material deformation of tension-resistant corner towers in ±500kV DC lines
publicationTitle: Annual Meeting of CSEE Study Committee of HVDC and Power Electronics (HVDC 2023)
abstract: Through modeling and analysis, at a wind speed of 10m/s, the D-leg bears an upward pulling force. With the line live, auxiliary main materials are used to transfer the force on the D-leg main materials, and the damaged main materials of the ± 500kV DC transmission line tension angle tower are replaced with live materials. The total construction time is 2 hours. Practice has proven that the scheme has strong operability and simple operation methods. While ensuring the safety of operations and equipment, the line does not need to be cut off, ensuring the reliability of power supply, and the economic benefits are considerable. It has strong reference significance in handling similar defects in transmission lines of other voltage levels.

articleTitle: Mechanism research on oscillatory switching of AC filter based on weak AC system
publicationTitle: Annual Meeting of CSEE Study Committee of HVDC and Power Electronics (HVDC 2023)
abstract: Under the operation mode of weak AC system, the coordinated control of converter tap changer and the switching sequence of the reactive power equipment in the converter station are of great significance for the stability of the AC bus voltage and the reactive power of the converter station. Based on the analysis of the oscillatory switching phenomenon of the AC filter in a converter station, this paper further considers the constraints of the local balance of reactive power to the AC system and the constraints of the range of the converter tap-changer. A multi-mode coordinated control strategy based on reactive power balance, independent control of converter transformer tap changer and AC filter switching is proposed. This control strategy can effectively prevent the adverse consequences of AC system voltage fluctuations and frequent actions of reactive equipment caused by the interaction of converter tap changer and AC filter switching due to weak AC system. The simulation results prove that the proposed multi-mode coordinated control strategy for the discrete regulation equipment of the converter station is suitable for the HVDC system connected to the weak AC system, and can effectively avoid the oscillatory switching of the AC filter.

articleTitle: A distributionally robust optimization method for power distribution of AC/DC parallel transmission channels with high proportion of renewable energy
publicationTitle: Annual Meeting of CSEE Study Committee of HVDC and Power Electronics (HVDC 2023)
abstract: Considering the uncertainty of renewable energy station output, a two-stage optimization model for AC/DC parallel transmission channel power distribution of a power system with high proportion of renewable energy is established based on distributionally robust optimization (DRO) method. The objective function of the first stage is to minimize the sum of active power loss costs of all transmission lines in the forecast scenario. The objective function of the second stage is to minimize the expected adjustment cost of directly dispatching generators and DC transmission lines power under the worst-case probability distribution (PD). When constructing the ambiguity set of PDs, Hellinger distance is used to measure the distance between real PD and reference PD, and Markov chain is used to describe the time correlation of renewable energy station output. The column and constraint generation algorithm is used to solve the two-stage DRO model to obtain the day-ahead power transmission schedules of AC/DC parallel transmission channels. Finally, the case study on the modified IEEE-39 bus system demonstrate the correctness and effectiveness of the proposed model and algorithm.

articleTitle: Study on mechanical damage properties of dry bushing core composites
publicationTitle: Annual Meeting of CSEE Study Committee of HVDC and Power Electronics (HVDC 2023)
abstract: The adhesive-impregnated paper dry bushing has the advantages of oil-free, explosion-proof, and stable electrical characteristics. It has been widely used in transformers, reactors, valve hall through walls and other scenarios, and is an important component of high-voltage electrical equipment. The capacitor core is the main insulating part of the bushing, and the Microscopic damage of the core composite material may eventually lead to mechanical and electrical failures of the equipment. The research on the damage properties of dry bushing core composite material is of great significance. In this paper, in order to accurately reflect the actual performance of composites in dry bushing core, samples were directly cut from the dry bushing core. The mechanical damage properties of dry bushing core composites have been tested and studied to obtain the relationship between microscopic damage and macroscopic failure values. The mechanical damage of the composite was studied by means of universal electronic tensile machine, acoustic emission technology, and 3D X-ray computed tomography technology, etc. The mechanical property data of the core composite material has been obtained, and the damage mechanism and process have been analyzed. This study provides basic material parameters and design principle of similar dry bushing.

articleTitle: Modeling of impedance external characteristics of DC impedance adapter and its adaptive simulation strategy
publicationTitle: Annual Meeting of CSEE Study Committee of HVDC and Power Electronics (HVDC 2023)
abstract: Aiming at the interactive instability problem of DC power system, under the demand of resistive-capacitive parallel simulation, this paper firstly designs the main circuit parameters and basic control strategy of impedance adapter based on Buck-Boost converter. Secondly, in order to explain the characteristics of the impedance adapter, the impedance model of it is established. Furthermore, an adaptive simulation strategy of capacitance and resistance of impedance adapter is proposed. Finally, the accuracy of the impedance model of the impedance adapter is illustrated by comparison with impedance measurements, and the effectiveness of the impedance adapter in resonance suppression is verified based on a two-terminal DC distribution system.

articleTitle: The influence of sampling frequency on traveling-wave protection for multi-terminal hybrid HVDC
publicationTitle: Annual Meeting of CSEE Study Committee of HVDC and Power Electronics (HVDC 2023)
abstract: In a multi-terminal hybrid HVDC system, modular multilevel converter (MMC) has faster control response than line commutation converter (LCC), which makes MMC require shorter action time of the HVDC line protection. For traveling wave protection for HVDC line, the sampling frequency is a factor of protection action time. Based on the PSCAD/EMTDC simulation model of three-terminal hybrid HVDC system, this paper studies the influences of sampling frequency on the performance of travelling wave protection. Firstly, the influence of different sampling frequencies on fault characteristics extraction is analyzed. It shows that the change of sampling frequency mainly affects the criteria based on line mode wave. Secondly, according to the fault characteristics, sensitivity and speed of traveling wave protection at different sampling frequencies are studied. Finally, some suggestions about the selection of sampling frequency are given from the aspects of overall performance of traveling wave protection.

articleTitle: Comparative analysis of the mutual conversion process of ground return and metallic return of multi-terminal hybrid VSC-HVDC and LCC-HVDC
publicationTitle: Annual Meeting of CSEE Study Committee of HVDC and Power Electronics (HVDC 2023)
abstract: The operation mode of the HVDC transmission system is diverse. When one of the poles is exit from operation due to failure or maintenance needs, it can be converted to a monopole ground return or metallic return operation.Among them, the monopole metallic return uses the DC line of this pole and the line of the other pole to form a DC current loop, which effectively avoids the long-term occurrence of ground current.With the development of smart grids, DC transmission tends to be multi-terminal, the operation methods are more diverse, and the ground return to metallic return conversion process is more complex. This paper combs the ground return to metallic return conversion logic of ±800kV Kun-Liu-Long multi-terminal hybrid VSC-HVDC and ±500kV Lu-Gao-Zhao multi-terminal LCC-HVDC, and conducts comparative analysis and research on it, which helps to improve the stability and reliability of multi-terminal DC system operation.

articleTitle: Design of transient reactive power control strategy for VSC-HVDC in multi-DC feed-in grid
publicationTitle: Annual Meeting of CSEE Study Committee of HVDC and Power Electronics (HVDC 2023)
abstract: VSC-HVDC access to the multi-DC infeed receiving end grid relieve the problem of AC and DC interaction, but there is a risk of increasing the short-circuit current in the near area. Reasonable design of control strategy for VSC in Multi-DC Feed-in Grid during AC faults is an important part of the engineering design. This paper firstly proposed the design principle of VSC's reactive power control strategy in Multi-DCs Feed-in Grid, then take the reactive power strategy design of the Guangdong Longmen converter station in the Kunliulong multi-terminal UHVDC Demonstration project as a case, and proposed control measures to delay the exit of VSC from low voltage ride through mode after AC fault removal. Finally, simulation of the large power grid is used to verify the effectiveness of the control strategy.

articleTitle: Effect of duty cycle on partial discharge characteristics of insulation in power electronic transformers
publicationTitle: Annual Meeting of CSEE Study Committee of HVDC and Power Electronics (HVDC 2023)
abstract: With the rapid development of power electronic technology, the application of power electronic transformer (PET) is more and more extensive, playing an important role in the distribution network, and has achieved significant economic benefits. However, PET insulation materials are often subjected to fast-rising and high-frequency impulsive voltage. Particularly, the duty cycle is an important parameter of impulsive voltage in pulse width modulation technology. The duty cycle of the repetitive square wave voltage can affect the insulation significantly, which has an important effect on the probability of partial discharge (PD). In order to study the effect of voltage duty cycle on PD characteristics of typical insulating polyimide (PI) films for PET, a high frequency PD test platform was built under repetitive square wave voltage with different duty cycles. The PD characteristic quantities and the phase resolved partial discharge (PRPD) patterns show that with the increase of duty cycle, the overall discharge amplitude and discharge number are basically unchanged. However, it is further found that the discharge amplitude of the rising edge decreases while that of the falling edge increases. Using space charge theory to analyze and verify the conclusion and guide PET insulation operation.

articleTitle: Study on insulation performance of RIP wall bushing capacitor core under cantilever load
publicationTitle: Annual Meeting of CSEE Study Committee of HVDC and Power Electronics (HVDC 2023)
abstract: The resin impregnated paper (RIP) wall bushing is the connecting equipment between the DC field and the valve hall in the converter station of the DC transmission project. Its operating conditions are harsh, and it needs to withstand mechanical, electrical, thermal and other stresses for a long time. Its reliability is critical to the system safety. The RIP wall bushing is a typical long cantilever structure, and the mechanical stress concentration is more prominent, so the research on its insulation performance under heavy load is of great significance. The current standards at home and abroad all carry out single factor test and assessment, which is different from the actual multi factor working condition. There is no report on the multi factor test and research of DC wall bushing. In this paper, the capacitor core of a typical RIP DC wall bushing scaling unit is taken as the research object, focuses on the insulation performance test of the capacitor core under heavy load. The test data show that the partial discharge quantity, dielectric dissipation factor (tanδ) and capacitance of the qualified capacitor core without cantilever load have not increased or changed under heavy load; For the capacitor core with unqualified partial discharge quantity when no cantilever load is applied, the partial discharge initial voltage and extinction voltage decrease significantly with the increase of test times when partial discharge measurements are made for many times. The research results provide reference for the production, test, operation and maintenance of similar products.

articleTitle: Black start strategy of grid-forming CIGs supplying passive island grids
publicationTitle: Annual Meeting of CSEE Study Committee of HVDC and Power Electronics (HVDC 2023)
abstract: The grid-forming converter-interfaced generations (GFM-CIGs) can supply the island grid independently without conventional power plants in future power systems. In island grid conditions, GFM-CIGs should have the black start capability to support a stable AC voltage for passive loads. In this paper, the black start strategy with an enhanced voltage control is provided for GFM-CIGs to supply passive island grids. Firstly, detailed control strategies of the GFM-CIGs are presented, including the heterogeneous active power-frequency control and improved voltage control with Q-V droop and virtual impedance control. Then, the proposed black start strategy for GFM-CIGs is elaborated. It considers the active power balancing between providing side and the demanding side and the synchronization period between each CIG. Finally, time-domain simulations in PSCAD/EMTDC verify the effectiveness and superiority of the proposed black strategy.

articleTitle: A chance-constrained power optimization method for MTDC considering PV and load uncertainties
publicationTitle: Annual Meeting of CSEE Study Committee of HVDC and Power Electronics (HVDC 2023)
abstract: Leveraging voltage source converter-based multi-terminal direct current system's (VSC-MTDC) advantage of multi-energy complementarity is significant for enhancing the economic operation of distribution network. This paper proposes a power scheduling strategy for VSC-MTDC considering PV and load uncertainties. Firstly, the impact of PV/load uncertainties on distribution network operation cost is analyzed. Secondly, an opportunity constraint-based power purchase cost model is constructed for the high-cost power purchase risk during peak hours under TOU price. Finally, a sampling-based deterministic transformation of opportunity constraints is used to deal with the opportunity constraints and accelerate its solution. By using the IEEE 33-bus system as an example, the effectiveness of the proposed method is validated.

articleTitle: Transient voltage stability assessment based on focal loss convolution autoencoder
publicationTitle: Annual Meeting of CSEE Study Committee of HVDC and Power Electronics (HVDC 2023)
abstract: Transient voltage stability assessment methods based on machine learning often rely on a large number of balanced labelled samples, but it is difficult to obtain these samples in practical systems. In order to realize transient voltage stability assessment under a small number of labelled samples and improve the ability of the model to identify unstable samples, a transient voltage stability assessment method based on focal loss convolution autoencoder (FL-CAE) is proposed. Firstly, a two-dimensional convolutional autoencoder (CAE) evaluation model is established to efficiently extract the potential features of the input time series multi-dimensional features; secondly, the focal loss (FL) function is introduced to adjust the attention to the difficult samples and unstable samples in the process of model training. and then improve the fitting degree of the model to the important samples. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed method is verified by a CEPRI-VC example of the Chinese Academy of Electrical Sciences, and the results show that the proposed method has higher evaluation accuracy and better ability to identify unstable samples when there are fewer labelled samples.

articleTitle: Optimization of arm overcurrent protection in valve control device for VSC-UHVDC transmission system
publicationTitle: Annual Meeting of CSEE Study Committee of HVDC and Power Electronics (HVDC 2023)
abstract: The transient overcurrent capacity of modular multilevel converter based VSC is relatively weaker than that of LCC. In order to avoid overcurrent damage of IGBT under fault conditions, arm overcurrent protection is configured both in valve control and DC protection devices of VSC. Aiming at VSC-UHVDC transmission system, the configuration scheme of arm overcurrent protection in valve control device is proposed along with the setting principles of operating current and resetting current, the AC/DC fault characteristics of VSC-UHVDC are studied, the risk of asynchronous temporary blocking between high voltage and low voltage converters is analyzed, and the collaborative temporary blocking strategy within high voltage and low voltage converters is proposed to improve the fault ride-through performance of VSC-UHVDC. The proposed configuration scheme of arm overcurrent protection in valve control device and collaborative temporary blocking strategy have been verified by the RTDS simulation experiment system of Kun-Liu-Long project, and have been applied in the project site. Simulation results verified the effectiveness of the proposed strategy.

articleTitle: Research on grid-connected photovoltaic technology with double closed-loop control based on zero-sequence voltage injection
publicationTitle: Annual Meeting of CSEE Study Committee of HVDC and Power Electronics (HVDC 2023)
abstract: With the global energy crisis and environmental pollution problems becoming more and more prominent, renewable energy has become a hot spot for research because of its clean, safe, non-polluting, renewable and other advantages. After years of technical accumulation, PV power generation technology has developed into a relatively mature new energy technology[1]. At present, PV cell efficiency, maximum power tracking and grid-connected inverter control are the key technologies of grid-connected PV power generation system[2]. This paper takes three-phase two-stage grid-connected inverter as the research object, and firstly constructs the mathematical model of PV cell to analyze its output characteristics, and introduces the calcula-tion method of each parameter in BOOST circuit and LCL filter circuit in detail. Then the mod-ulation algorithm and grid-connected control method of three-phase PV grid-connected inverter are studied. For the traditional SVPWM which requires complex sector determination and vec-tor decomposition calculation, This paper proposes an improved zero-sequence voltage injec-tion control strategy based on SPWM, and establishes a grid-connected inverter vector control model with grid voltage orientation based on the mathematical model of three-phase grid-connected inverter in d/q synchronous rotation coordinate system. Finally, the grid-connected model of the PV system is built in simulink, and the simulation results verify the feasibility and superiority of the proposed control strategy.

articleTitle: Analysis of the causes and countermeasures of ice melting faults in ordinary ground lines of 500kV transmission lines
publicationTitle: Annual Meeting of CSEE Study Committee of HVDC and Power Electronics (HVDC 2023)
abstract: This paper analyzes an unsuccessful reason of ice melting of 500 kV transmission line common ground wire, and puts forward some countermeasures. Based on the analysis of the factors such as line maintenance, overhaul and technical renovation, and the topography of the tower, it is considered that the galloping of the overhead ground wire under the action of wind force causes the insufficient distance between the jumper of the overhead ground wire and the tower body, that caused the ground to fail to melt. Combined with the actual situation of transmission line, the measures such as installing supporting insulators and placing jumper wires along the top of the tower can effectively avoid the problem of insufficient electric distance between grounding jumper and tower caused by wind force. The method of reconstruction is safe, simple, effective, economical and reliable, and the success rate of ground wire deicing is effectively guaranteed.

articleTitle: A novel topology intergrating DC Fault isolation and AC/DC fault ride-through
publicationTitle: Annual Meeting of CSEE Study Committee of HVDC and Power Electronics (HVDC 2023)
abstract: Bipolar modular multilevel converter (MMC) based multi-terminal flexible DC transmission system (MTDC) has been the preferred choice for the regional sharing of wind power. The dc fault isolation and dc fault ride-through during dc faults is one of the greatest challenges, the methods used to interrupt fault current and dissipate surplus wind power are indispensable. In this article, a novel topology with the cooperation of control strategy is proposed, which achieves dc fault isolation and dc fault ride-through under the dc faults occur on the dc transmission line (DCTL) and ac fault ride-through under the ac fault occurs on the grid-side MMC (GSMMC) ac network. Based on the simulation of four-terminal MTDC, it can be verified that the proposed topology can reduce 20 % utilization of power electronic devices to ensure the operation of the healthy area under the fault area isolation.

articleTitle: Research on simplified calculation method of sag-temperature of transmission line based on data drive
publicationTitle: Annual Meeting of CSEE Study Committee of HVDC and Power Electronics (HVDC 2023)
abstract: The detection and calculation of sag of transmission lines under high temperature and heavy load conditions have an important impact on the operation safety of power grid. This paper proposes a simplified calculation method of sag temperature of transmission lines based on data drive, which is based on multi-period point cloud data collected by helicopter lidar and unmanned aerial vehicle photogrammetry. A fast extraction method of point cloud based on transmission line conduction and ground wire is established, and a method to deal with the influence of missing point cloud or noise of conduction and ground wire is proposed. The feasibility and effectiveness of the proposed method are verified by comparing the measured data of sag temperature of transmission lines in actual operation of our unit with the related calculation parameters in design stage. The research method can quickly calculate the accurate sag at different temperatures, effectively eliminate the error influence caused by using design parameters, and improve the calculation efficiency and accuracy.

articleTitle: Application of embedded video and image recognition technology in intelligent monitoring of overhead transmission lines
publicationTitle: Annual Meeting of CSEE Study Committee of HVDC and Power Electronics (HVDC 2023)
abstract: The intelligent monitoring system of transmission lines consists of modules such as storage servers, communication channels and embedded videos. After shooting relevant image videos on the spot, embedded video automatically recognizes overhead lines and environmental risks, such as floating objects, large-scale mechanical construction and wire arc drape changes, through chroma extraction, trajectory tracking, CANNY edge detection, vector machine classification and other image recognition methods, and conducts, and conducts early warning and transmits information to the server regularly, which can effectively save communication costs. The intelligent monitoring system provides strong support for the external environmental monitoring of transmission lines and has broad application potential.

articleTitle: Hybrid energy storage capacity optimization and configuration method for microgrids in the new energy internet environment
publicationTitle: Annual Meeting of CSEE Study Committee of HVDC and Power Electronics (HVDC 2023)
abstract: Under the guidance of the "dual carbon" development goals, the new marketing and sales methods of green energy, such as wind-solar coupling and hydrogen production, are rapidly evolving, presenting new challenges for the development of the energy internet. Due to insufficient engineering experience and the volatility of wind-solar resources and hydrogen production loads, uncertainties accumulate at both ends of the supply and demand, which can affect the stability of the wind-solar-hydrogen microgrid operation. The application of hybrid energy storage devices, such as electricity and hydrogen storage, can effectively address these issues. Therefore, this paper first targets the microgrid scenario with wind-solar coupled hydrogen production, aiming for optimal economic performance. It constructs an optimization model for microgrid operation that includes hybrid energy storage. Subsequently, through capacity optimization and configuration of hybrid energy storage, energy balance between supply and demand is achieved, and the reliability of microgrid operation is enhanced. The model and optimization algorithm are validated through specific case studies, and corresponding configurations for hybrid energy storage are proposed.

articleTitle: A broadband oscillation source location method based on LSTM variational autoencoder and graph convolutional neural network
publicationTitle: Annual Meeting of CSEE Study Committee of HVDC and Power Electronics (HVDC 2023)
abstract: With the increasing of high proportion of new energy and high proportion of power electronic equipment, wideband oscillation phenomena in the power system from several Hz to hundreds Hz have been induced. However, the existing oscillation monitoring methods based on synchronous phasor data are limited by the sampling theorem and communication bandwidth, making it difficult to monitor all frequency bands. Therefore, this paper proposes a wideband oscillation disturbance source localization method based on LSTM variational autoencoder signal compression and graph convolutional neural network. This method encodes and compresses the measurement signals at the substation to adapt to the limited communication bandwidth. Then, the main station uses the compressed data, combined with system topology information, to locate the oscillation source through a graph convolutional neural network. Through simulation verification, the results show that this method has high data recovery and oscillation source localization accuracy under small sample learning.

articleTitle: Analysis of key influenceing factors on AC/DC impedance of MMC based on Sobol impedance sensitivity method
publicationTitle: Annual Meeting of CSEE Study Committee of HVDC and Power Electronics (HVDC 2023)
abstract: For the oscillation suppression methods of MMC-based high voltage direct current (MMC-HVDC) systems, it is crucial to analyse the key influencing factors of impedance characteristics. The existing analyses, however, are primarily qualitative and limited to a single frequency, making it impossible to conduct a quantitative analysis of the impedance properties under different frequency bands. To solve this problem, this paper suggests an impedance sensitivity method based on Sobol to analyse the key factors affecting the AC/DC impedances of MMC. Firstly, taking the converter station with constant voltage control as an example, impedance models on the AC/DC side of MMC are established based on the harmonic state space (HSS) method. And the correctness of the impedance models is verified through frequency scanning. Subsequently, the principle of impedance sensitivity analysis method based on Sobol is introduced and the impedance sensitivity analysis method is applied to the AC and DC impedance models of MMC. Finally, the key influencing factors of MMC's AC and DC impedance in different frequency bands are obtained.

articleTitle: Analysis of the results of two algorithms based on satellite monitoring wildfires
publicationTitle: Annual Meeting of CSEE Study Committee of HVDC and Power Electronics (HVDC 2023)
abstract: In the practice of fire monitoring in the power grid, the regional algorithm of Liuzhou Bureau is adjusted, and the effect of the adjustment of the fire point algorithm in Liuzhou Bureau is comprehensively analyzed using the original algorithm and the fire point monitoring data of the adjusted algorithm of the adjusted algorithm, so as to provide a practical reference for the adjustment of the algorithm strategy of fire point monitoring in the power grid field. This paper uses the fire point monitoring data of the original algorithm and the adjusted algorithm from October 1, 2022 to February 13, 2023 to compare and analyze the number of fire points and hot spots monitored before and after the adjustment of the algorithm. The adjusted algorithm monitors small area fire points, which is more fire points than the original algorithm, which responds well to the fire point monitoring needs of Liuzhou Bureau. After statistical analysis, it is found that the adjusted algorithm does not fully contain the original algorithm fire points. Because the two types of algorithms have a certain deviation in positioning of the same fire point, it is difficult to accurately judge the same fire point in statistics. In the future, it is necessary to improve the positioning accuracy of the algorithm, improve the statistical method, and improve the algorithm of satellite remote sensing to identify fire points in the field of power grid from these two aspects.

articleTitle: Prevention and control strategy for commutation failure in UHVDC hierarchical connection systems based on harmonic voltage coordination
publicationTitle: Annual Meeting of CSEE Study Committee of HVDC and Power Electronics (HVDC 2023)
abstract: In the ultra-high voltage DC hierarchical connection system, due to the electrical coupling of the receiving system, when a fault occurs in a certain layer of AC system, it may lead to commutation failure of the non-fault layer inverter. Therefore, considering the changes in voltage harmonics of the receiving end commutation bus after a fault, a commutation failure prevention control strategy based on harmonic voltage coordination is proposed. This strategy takes into account the changes in voltage harmonics of the receiving end commutation bus after a fault, dynamically adjusts the command value of the voltage dependent current order limiter (VDCOL), and improves its response speed; At the same time, based on the voltage harmonics, the trigger angle correction value for early triggering is obtained, which acts in parallel with the original commutation failure prevention control (CFPREV) to improve the response accuracy of the non-fault layer commutation failure prevention controller. Build a simulation model for ultra-high voltage hierarchical connection in PSCAD/EMTDC to verify the proposed control strategies under different operating conditions. The results show that this strategy can reduce the probability of simultaneous commutation failure of high and low end converters, and improve the recovery speed of the system after faults.

articleTitle: Adaptive fault current limiting strategy for flexible DC power grids based on deep neural networks
publicationTitle: Annual Meeting of CSEE Study Committee of HVDC and Power Electronics (HVDC 2023)
abstract: The flexible DC power network has the characteristics of low inertia and low damping, which makes the DC fault short-circuit current rise quickly. The existing research schemes by adding current limiting devices and improving converter topology will increase the investment cost. To reduce the breaking current of the DC circuit breaker (DCCB), an adaptive current limiting strategy for a modular multilevel converter (MMC) is proposed in this paper. Firstly, considering that the analytical formula of fault current in a flexible DC power grid is difficult to obtain, a fault current prediction method based on deep neural networks (DNN) is proposed in this paper. Secondly, based on the prediction of fault current, a matching strategy of MMC submodule input coefficient which ADAPTS to fault severity is proposed. Finally, a four-terminal flexible DC grid simulation model is built on the PSCAD/EMTDC platform to verify the effectiveness of the proposed adaptive current limiting control strategy. The simulation results show that the proposed adaptive current limiting control strategy reduces the breaking current of DCCB by 53.3%, 33.3%, and 16.1%, respectively. The proposed strategy is sensitive and effective to different fault locations and transition resistance.

articleTitle: Electric field distribution characteristics of submarine cable flexible joint under switching overvoltage
publicationTitle: Annual Meeting of CSEE Study Committee of HVDC and Power Electronics (HVDC 2023)
abstract: Flexible joints are a key technology for achieving large length submarine cable lines, but they are also one of the weakest parts of submarine cable lines. This article takes the 220kV cross-linked polyethylene (XLPE) submarine cable flexible joint as an example, establishes a model of the flexible joint through COMSOL Multiphysics, and obtains the electric field distribution of the flexible joint under switching overvoltage. The results show that the field intensity at each position of the flexible joint is proportional to the electric potential at that position, and the waveform is consistent with the applied switching overvoltage excitation. Due to the overall structure of the flexible joint, the root area of the stress cone will experience field intensity concentration distortion and becomes the weak point. So, this article further studies the influence of the dielectric constant of the new and old insulation recovery zone, the recovery insulation thickness, and the stress cone angle on the field intensity changes of the weak point of the flexible joint.

articleTitle: Research and application of CNN-based transmission line hazard identification technology
publicationTitle: Annual Meeting of CSEE Study Committee of HVDC and Power Electronics (HVDC 2023)
abstract: With the rapid development of the power industry, the safety and reliability of transmission lines have become a focal point of attention. In this study, a new method for front-end hazard identification of transmission line images using convolutional neural networks (CNN) based on deep learning technology is investigated. Transmission line images are collected and a deep learning model is established for image analysis and defect recognition. Preprocessing techniques such as image enhancement, segmentation, and denoising are applied to improve the quality and analysis effectiveness of the collected images. Field verification demonstrates the feasibility and effectiveness of this method, indicating its significant application value in enhancing the safety of transmission lines.

articleTitle: A restoration model for AC/DC distribution network based on multi-mode flexible interconnection
publicationTitle: Annual Meeting of CSEE Study Committee of HVDC and Power Electronics (HVDC 2023)
abstract: Using the flexible interconnection device to transform the distribution network can realize the flexible and efficient interaction between the load and storage of the source network, realize the rapid isolation and recovery of faults, and solve the power quality problems caused by the large number of distributed power sources. A fault recovery model of AC/DC distribution network based on multi-mode flexible interconnection is proposed for flexible interconnection in station area. Firstly, the flexible interconnection device networking mode and the model of flexible interconnection device and optical storage-charge-load element are established. Then, based on the distribution network model, taking emergency operation cost and network loss as optimization objectives, a restoration model of AC/DC distribution network based on multi-mode flexible interconnection is proposed. The optimal solution of the model is obtained by invoking Gurobi solver. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed model and the algorithm is verified by an example of a hybrid distribution network system.

articleTitle: Research on the state evaluation method of C1 capacitor of HVDC filter based on fuzzy algorithm
publicationTitle: Annual Meeting of CSEE Study Committee of HVDC and Power Electronics (HVDC 2023)
abstract: Aiming at the problem that the state of the C1 capacitor of the DC filter in the HVDC station cannot be evaluated, this paper proposes a method for evaluating the state of the C1 capacitor of the HVDC filter based on fuzzy comprehensive evaluation. By comprehensively considering the factors such as the capacitance deviation value of each capacitor unit, operating environment, protection action and operating life, a fuzzy comprehensive evaluation model of C1 capacitor is established, which can realize the comprehensive state evaluation of C1 capacitor. The correctness of the model is verified by on-site random sampling test, which provides technical support for operation and maintenance personnel to carry out equipment state evaluation.

articleTitle: Brief discussion on the impact of ice covering on high-voltage transmission lines
publicationTitle: Annual Meeting of CSEE Study Committee of HVDC and Power Electronics (HVDC 2023)
abstract: The extreme weather conditions in northwest China are relatively complex, which is easy to adversely affect the safety of the power grid, especially the high-voltage transmission lines, among which the impact of ice cover is the most prominent. This paper analyzes the five forms of rain song, fog song, wet snow, mixed ice and frost of high-voltage transmission lines, and summarizes the types of ice accumulation in high-voltage transmission lines in a certain area, mainly fog song, and the ,more mountainous than plains, and wet areas are more than dry areas.

articleTitle: Impacts of low frequency side operation frequency on M3C submodule capacitance values
publicationTitle: Annual Meeting of CSEE Study Committee of HVDC and Power Electronics (HVDC 2023)
abstract: Low-frequency AC transmission (LFAC) technology enters a new stage of development and plays an important role in energy transition, and Modular Multilevel Matrix Converter (M3C) is the core component for frequency conversion. This paper analyses the impact on the M3C submodule capacitor parameter from low frequency side operation frequency. Firstly, the equivalent circuit and mathematical mode of M3C is established. Then, the analytical expression for the submodule capacitor voltage and voltage fluctuation are derived. To achieve the same voltage fluctuation rate, the required submodule capacitor value are calculated under different operation frequencies and operation conditions. The result shows that the frequency value corresponding to the minimum submodule capacitor value generally lies between 17 Hz and 25 Hz.

articleTitle: Study on a coupled model of soil hydrothermal field considering the heat transfer of grounded conductor in soil freezing process
publicationTitle: Annual Meeting of CSEE Study Committee of HVDC and Power Electronics (HVDC 2023)
abstract: Tibet is rich in new energy, but when building energy transmission channels, due to the special climatic conditions in the region, the operation of transmission lines will face the conditions of coexistence of frozen soil and lightning. Therefore, after the cold snap comes and the surface soil freeze, it is necessary to predict the operation state of the grounding device to determine whether there is a failure of dispersed flow performance. The scattering performance of grounding conductor is closely related to soil temperature, so it is necessary to establish a coupled hydrothermal field model of soil. Generally, the coupled hydrothermal field model of soil assumes that the frozen soil is a static horizontal layered structure. It ignores the factor of heat transfer from grounded conductors during soil freezing. Therefore, a coupled model of soil hydrothermal field considering the heat transfer of grounded conductor is established, the soil structure under different freezing times is calculated. The results show that considering the heat transfer of conductors has a great influence on the soil temperature distribution. This study provides a basis for the design of grounding devices in frozen ground areas.

articleTitle: Study on the grid connection characteristics of multi-terminal new energy system
publicationTitle: Annual Meeting of CSEE Study Committee of HVDC and Power Electronics (HVDC 2023)
abstract: For AC/DC hybrid microgrids with new energy access, new energy is naturally characterised by stochasticity and volatility, which pose challenges to the safe and stable operation of the system. Based this situation, the grid-connection characteristics of a multi-terminal new energy system is investigated in this paper. Firstly, the simulation analysis of the grid-connection characteristics of the key equipments in the new energy system is carried out to verify the feasibility of the main parameters and the control strategy of the key equipments; then the grid-connection characteristics of the 2-terminal new energy system, the 3-terminal new energy system and the 4-terminal new energy system are investigated respectively, and the reasonableness of the synergistic control of the new energy system power is verified; finally, using the low-voltage dynamic modelling platform, test is carried out for verifying the grid-connection characteristics of the 2-terminal and 3-terminal new energy systems, and it is shown that the test results are consistent with the simulation results. This paper provides theoretical support for the design and safe operation of AC/DC microgrids with new energy access.

articleTitle: Impedance modeling and shaping method of offshore wind farm integration through MMC-HVDC with zero-sequence circulation control
publicationTitle: Annual Meeting of CSEE Study Committee of HVDC and Power Electronics (HVDC 2023)
abstract: Based on impedance analysis, this paper studies the stability of Offshore wind farm integration based on a permanent magnetic synchronous generator (PMSG) through the MMC-HVDC system and focuses on the control of MMC zero-sequence circulating current (ZSCC). Firstly, the impedance model of a permanent magnetic synchronous generator (PMSG) and sending-terminal MMC is built by multi-harmonic linearization, and then the influence of frequency coupling effect on the impedance model is analysed. Secondly, a zero-sequence circulation current impedance shaping control method is proposed to suppress the oscillation of MMC effectively. Finally, the stability analysis and the impedance modeling method are verified by RT-LAB hardware in the loop real-time simulation system.

articleTitle: Embedded DC transmission technology and its application in Jiangsu power grid
publicationTitle: Annual Meeting of CSEE Study Committee of HVDC and Power Electronics (HVDC 2023)
abstract: With the large-scale access of renewable energy and the growth of electricity load in southern Jiangsu region, the demand for north-south transmission of electricity in Jiangsu power grid and the pressure on the transmission channel of Yangtze-river-crossing section have been increasing. Embedded DC transmission technology, as a new form of intra-provincial transmission technology, is an effective technical means to cope with the current tension of the transmission channel of Yangtze-river-crossing section of the Jiangsu power grid. In this paper, various feasible technical schemes for embedded DC transmission in the province are firstly studied, and the advantages and disadvantages of various technical schemes are analyzed. Then an economic and technical comparison of various DC schemes is made through actual data and electromagnetic transient simulation. Finally, the application effect of embedded DC transmission in Jiangsu power grid is verified by the actual planning data of Jiangsu power grid. The results show that the embedded DC transmission technology can effectively alleviate the transmission pressure of Yangtze-river-crossing section of the Jiangsu power grid, and can improve the voltage stability of the Jiangsu power grid to a certain extent.

articleTitle: Finite element method based modal analysis of transformers
publicationTitle: Annual Meeting of CSEE Study Committee of HVDC and Power Electronics (HVDC 2023)
abstract: This chapter constructs a three-dimensional model of the transformer, conducts modal analysis on the transformer, and studies the influence of insulation pads and elastic modulus on the natural frequency of the overall winding. The research results indicate that as the thickness of the spacer increases, the natural frequency of the entire winding decreases. The increase in elastic modulus increases the natural frequency of the entire winding.

articleTitle: A flexible configuration design scheme for stability strategy via visual configuration tool
publicationTitle: Annual Meeting of CSEE Study Committee of HVDC and Power Electronics (HVDC 2023)
abstract: In order to solve the differences in the functions, external interfaces, pressing plate arrangement, setting values, and strategy descriptions of the power grid security and stability control device, and to avoid the difficulty of the operation and maintenance of the stability control device by the relevant units of the power grid company, a system is designed. The visual configuration tool abstracts the verified core module input, output, parameter definition, etc. into flexible configurable modules, realizing the construction of the overall logic in a visual form, and finally generating output files in a standardized description language. The device implements the functional strategy by parsing the above files. When the system changes and expands, the tool can be used to remodify the configuration according to the new functional requirements to achieve new functional changes, thereby improving the implementation efficiency of the project. The core modules of the standardized device generated by this method are all verified. It is convenient for onsite maintenance, and also greatly improves the reliability of device operation.

articleTitle: Analysis of rectifier circuits based on offshore wind farm
publicationTitle: Annual Meeting of CSEE Study Committee of HVDC and Power Electronics (HVDC 2023)
abstract: This paper analyses theoretically the rectifier circuit of the offshore wind farm transmission system based on diode rectifier unit, and select the series multiple connection and parallel multiple connection of 12-pulse rectifier circuit and 24-pulse rectifier circuit, which are widely used. And this paper studies the harmonic characteristics of AC current and DC voltage. The calculation method of harmonic frequency and amplitude is obtained, the total harmonic distortion rate of current and the voltage ripple factor are calculated. The simulation of cases is to verify the theoretical analysis of this paper based on PSCAD/EMTDC.

articleTitle: Cause analysis and anti-vibration performance study of gas relay in the process of no-load closing of converter transformer
publicationTitle: Annual Meeting of CSEE Study Committee of HVDC and Power Electronics (HVDC 2023)
abstract: This paper introduced the faults of alarm signal and trip signal of gas relay for converter transformer and bushings during the no-load closing process of a converter transformer. It explained the structure and operation principle of the gas relay, and carried out the inspection of the converter transformer and the gas relay and studied the anti-vibration performance of the gas relay. According to the test results, the reasons for the malfunction of the gas relay are obtained, and the measures to prevent the malfunction of the gas relay are proposed.

articleTitle: Multi-objective fault reconfiguration plan of power network considering soft open point
publicationTitle: Annual Meeting of CSEE Study Committee of HVDC and Power Electronics (HVDC 2023)
abstract: Under the premise of renewable energy access to power network, the reconfiguration plan of power network with soft open point (SOP) after fault is studied, and the fault reconfiguration strategy of power network considering SOP is proposed. Firstly, the SOP model is constructed. Then, considering the degree of load recovery, voltage deviation and network load imbalance degree, a multi-objective power network fault reconfiguration model considering SOP is established under the condition of renewable energy access. Then, for the three-objective optimization reconfiguration problem, an improved normalized normal constraint (NNC) method is used to solve the complete Pareto frontier to obtain a compromised optimal solution. Finally, taking the improved IEEE 33 node distribution system as an example, the analysis results show that the distribution network reconfiguration strategy considering SOP can effectively improve the ability of distribution network to restore power supply.

articleTitle: Impedance reshaping strategy of PMSG-based wind power generation system with weak grid
publicationTitle: Annual Meeting of CSEE Study Committee of HVDC and Power Electronics (HVDC 2023)
abstract: Due to the extensive application of permanent magnet synchronous generators (PMSG) in offshore wind power, the stability issues caused by weak grid are becoming increasingly significant. The importance of study on the stability of power generation system is becoming more and more prominent. Firstly, the small-signal model of PMSG wind power generation system is established under the premise that the turbine side is equivalent to a controlled current source. Secondly, the stability of the grid-connected system with condition of weak grid is analysed, especially the side effect of phase-locked loop (PLL), and a q-axis voltage feedforward control strategy is proposed. Finally, the effectiveness of the strategy is verified in the state-space small-signal model and the simulation model on MATLAB/Simulink.

articleTitle: Analysis of the discharge characteristics of the grading ring at the end of the wall bushing in high-altitude areas
publicationTitle: Annual Meeting of CSEE Study Committee of HVDC and Power Electronics (HVDC 2023)
abstract: The construction of ultra-high voltage transmission projects in high-altitude areas of southwest China is of great significance for promoting the transformation of China's energy structure and achieving the 'carbon peaking and carbon neutrality goals'. The converter station is a hub to ensure the smooth operation of ultra-high voltage transmission in the region. As the core equipment inside the valve hall of the converter station, the wall bushing is of great significance for the safe and stable operation of the converter station. This article establishes a ± 800kV wall bushing model and geometric models of different sizes of grading rings for a certain converter station, and conducts electrostatic field simulation analysis to study the impact of grading rings on the discharge characteristics of wall bushings. The electric field strength distribution from the bottom of the grading ring to the surface of the plate electrode is obtained, and the optimal grading ring size is determined. Then, the correctness of the selected grading ring size is verified from an experimental perspective. The work in this article can provide reference for the selection of air clearance for the end fittings of valve hall equipment in high-altitude converter stations, and has guiding significance for the optimization of external insulation design in power transmission and transformation projects in high-altitude areas.

articleTitle: Few-shot image generation method for power defect detection
publicationTitle: Annual Meeting of CSEE Study Committee of HVDC and Power Electronics (HVDC 2023)
abstract: Electric power is an indispensable and important element in economic development and engineering construction, and the stable operation of the power system is of great significance. Once the power equipment has defects and failures, it will affect the safe and stable operation of the power system and have a significant impact on the country and society. At present, due to the scarcity of power defect data, most defect detection methods cannot effectively detect power defects accurately. Aiming at the problem of scarcity of defect data, this paper uses the method of few-shot image generation to propose an improved LoFGAN network, and designs a few-shot image generator based on context information, which improves the ability of the defect detection network to extract detailed features. The method based on LC-scatter regularized loss of divergence is introduced to optimize the training effect of image generation models on limited datasets. Experiments show that the few-shot image generation method proposed in this paper can generate real and diverse defect data for power scene defects. The improved LoFGAN surpasses the latest images such as FIGR and DAWSON Generate network.

articleTitle: Research on the application of visible light modeling technology in automatic driving of transmission lines
publicationTitle: Annual Meeting of CSEE Study Committee of HVDC and Power Electronics (HVDC 2023)
abstract: The original photo data is collected by the S-shaped flight mode (visible light) of the Elf 4RTK aircraft, and the three-dimensional point cloud model is generated by combining the software in the DJI intelligent map image data. The accuracy can reach the centimeter level when the network RTK signal is good. Load the high-precision point cloud file through the PC-side automatic planning software, plan the track on the point cloud, control the position of the point, the angle of the head, and the plane to achieve the best shooting parameters. Finally, export the xml track file, and use the mobile APP to load the track file to realize the overhead line.

articleTitle: A SVPWM method for improving the zero crossing distortion of Vienna rectifier
publicationTitle: Annual Meeting of CSEE Study Committee of HVDC and Power Electronics (HVDC 2023)
abstract: Three-phase three-wire Vienna rectifier is one of the popular three-level topologies for AC-DC conversion. However, it usually suffers from the zero crossing distortion. This paper firstly introduces the basic operating principle of the three-phase Vienna rectifier, and then analyzes the space vector pulse width modulation (SVPWM) based on the two-level equivalent. Secondly, based on the Vienna rectifier in the dq rotating coordinate system, an optimized SVPWM is proposed to deal with the neutral-point voltage imbalance and input current zero crossing distortion in the traditional seven-stage SVPWM, which adopts the hybrid modulation method of seven-stage and five-stage SVPWM near the input current zero crossing. Clamp redundant vectors are used to suppress zero-crossing distortion of the input current. Finally, Matlab/Simulink simulation verifies the feasibility and superiority of the improved SVPWM for the neutral-point voltage imbalance and the suppression of zero-crossing distortion in the rectifier.

articleTitle: Lightning impulse flashover arc observation and post-arc gas analysis of series air gap outside line arrester
publicationTitle: Annual Meeting of CSEE Study Committee of HVDC and Power Electronics (HVDC 2023)
abstract: The multi-chamber arc extinguishing device can protect insulators and suppress the existence of fault arc, which has the potential to become a supplementary protection measure for distribution network lines. As the basic unit of the semi-closed chamber, the evolution process of the impulse flashover arc in the chamber still lacks complete observation means, intuitive comparison of different electrode structures and quantitative analysis of the post-arc gas state. In order to further improve the observation method of arc evolution process in semi-closed chamber and optimize the structural design, a high-speed schlieren system for observing arc and post-arc gas evolution in semi-closed chamber is built in this paper. The evolution process of impulse flashover arc and post-arc gas dissipation process in open air gap and semi-closed air gap are compared and analyzed. The schlieren image of the arc evolution process shows that the semi-closed chamber has an active ' arc blowing ' effect compared with the open air gap. The back-arc gas evolves into an approximate vortex ring structure, which promotes the gas density in the vicinity of the chamber outlet to recover first, and the air self-recovery ability is improved.

articleTitle: Optimization of the coordination between automatic busbar transfer and valve cooling main pump switching in the Yungui interconnection channel project
publicationTitle: Annual Meeting of CSEE Study Committee of HVDC and Power Electronics (HVDC 2023)
abstract: The automatic busbar transfer of station power and valve cooling system are important components of the Yungui Interconnection Channel Project. The mutual coordination and interaction between the automatic busbar transfer of station power and valve cooling system main pump ensure the safe and stable operation of the DC transmission project. The ± 500kV Luquan Converter Station is the first end converter station of the Yungui Interconnection Channel Project. There are abnormalities in the daily operation and maintenance of the automatic busbar transfer of station power and valve cooling system main pump switching. This article analyzes and studies the abnormalities, proposes optimization measures, and has important significance for the safe operation and maintenance of the three terminal DC transmission project.

articleTitle: Development of coaxial discharge multi-output pusle trigger with fast rise time based on high voltage silicon reactor rectifier energy storage
publicationTitle: Annual Meeting of CSEE Study Committee of HVDC and Power Electronics (HVDC 2023)
abstract: It is of great significance to study the multi-output trigger that can work stably in strong electromagnetic environment and harsh working conditions for the trigger link of electromagnetic pulse simulation device. In this study, a five-channel output trigger platform with coaxial structure based on silicon stack rectification and capacitor charging and discharging is designed and built. The field simulation optimization check of key components of the structure is carried outd. The preliminary test shows that the output effect of the trigger device based on this design structure is good, and it can generate high-voltage pulses with leading edge less than 10ns and amplitude not less than 50kV under the condition of five outputs.

articleTitle: Analysis of an abnormal power transfer fault in ±800kV multiterminal flexible DC transmission system
publicationTitle: Annual Meeting of CSEE Study Committee of HVDC and Power Electronics (HVDC 2023)
