abstract: This thesis analyzes an abnormal power transfer fault of ± 800kV flexible DC transmission system, deeply analyzes the factors of DC power transfer in combination with the fault phenomenon, then determines the root cause of this fault from the structure and working principle of the auxiliary node buffer device of the line switch. When the bus switch body is closed, the differential buffer device baffle is tilted, which leads to the incorrect triggering of the differential microswitch, The improvement measures for the operation and maintenance of the busbar switch and the selection of key components are proposed.

articleTitle: A hybrid feedforward scheme for LCL grid-connected inverters
publicationTitle: Annual Meeting of CSEE Study Committee of HVDC and Power Electronics (HVDC 2023)
abstract: The unit feedforward scheme of the point of common coupling (PCC) voltage has been widely used for LCL grid-connected inverter to alleviate its adverse effect of background harmonics on the grid current. Accordingly, a pair of unstable open-loop poles will arise when the LCL resonance frequency (fr) is higher than one-third of the sampling frequency (fs/3), and the inverter robustness against the grid impedance variation becomes poor. To address this issue, a hybrid feedforward scheme is proposed in this paper. By feeding forward the filter capacitor voltage and the PCC voltage with proper weighted coefficients, the open-loop unstable poles can be avoided even if fr is higher than fs/3, regardless of the grid impedance variation. Experiments are performed on a 6-kW prototype to validate the effectiveness of the proposed feedforward schemes.

articleTitle: Design and development of an auxiliary tool for on-site calibration of electricity meters based on image recognition
publicationTitle: Annual Meeting of CSEE Study Committee of HVDC and Power Electronics (HVDC 2023)
abstract: Electricity metering device is a basic tool for measuring electric energy, in order to ensure that the electricity metering device scientific, fair, accurate and reasonable to provide quality service, must reduce the comprehensive error of the electricity metering device. However, due to technical as well as management and other factors, in the actual power measurement calibration, there are many shortcomings, such as through the manual transcription of data in the form of calibration of the form of unit by unit, manual entry of information is time-consuming, reading is not standardized, less accurate, manual finishing calculations of the workload is large, is not convenient for statistical analysis of the data and the value of mining applications, and so on. In view of the above problems, advanced image recognition technology is adopted to collect working images of power meters and standard calibration measuring instruments and devices through intelligent mobile operation terminals, automatically identify the model, asset code, nameplate parameters and other information of power meters and measurement calibration devices, develop image recognition-based power meter field calibration aids, and form detailed power meter On-site calibration data files are formed with pictures, identification information and business information. Simultaneously generate original records, automatically entered into the electronic form, convenient can be directly imported into the relevant systems, in order to improve the process of power metering data collection and processing efficiency and the accuracy of the error measurement results, to achieve the lean management of the test process.

articleTitle: Improved dual-mode control strategy of NPC based MMC under wide-load range for HVDC system of offshore wind farms
publicationTitle: Annual Meeting of CSEE Study Committee of HVDC and Power Electronics (HVDC 2023)
abstract: DC offshore wind farms require DC/DC converter with high step-up ratio and high power and voltage withstand capability to connect medium voltage (MV) DC and HVDC side, multi-level modular converter (MMC) technique is widely used in HVDC grid. In several MMC topologies, resonant three level neutral-point-clamped (3L-NPC) converter could reduce the stress of power device and adapt to high voltage level. However, in high-frequency operating condition, the zero-voltage-switching (ZVS) condition of resonant converter is related to load condition, which make the ZVS failure occur in light-load condition, efficiency degradation under light-load condition with traditional ON/OFF control limit the load range of resonant converter for HVDC application in wind energy system. In this paper, optimal control strategy with a novel dual-mode ON/OFF control strategy is proposed, reason of ZVS failure and efficiency degradation under light-load condition are analyzed and derived, the parameter derivation procedure is discussed in detail, duty ratio D and frequency parameters of two modes is determined with equivalent gain principle, then a downscaled power converter is built, simulation and experimental result verify the feasibility of this improved control strategy under wide-load condition.

articleTitle: Simulation research on primary frequency regulation coordination control strategy of hybrid wind-PV-ES power station based on AGC
publicationTitle: Annual Meeting of CSEE Study Committee of HVDC and Power Electronics (HVDC 2023)
abstract: With the increase of wind and solar renewable energy penetration in power system, the frequency control ability of power system completely depending on traditional power supply has weakened. This actuality requires that renewable energy stations should be equipped with a certain amount of energy storage to improve the primary frequency control ability. This paper considers the fast response ability and flexible control of energy storage for both charging and discharging, as well as its unique frequency response characteristics. Firstly, the control characteristics of the primary frequency regulation of the hybrid wind-solar-storage power station(Wind-PV-ES) are analyzed. By improving the automatic generation control(AGC) strategy of the hybrid Wind-PV-ES power station, a coordinated control strategy for the primary frequency regulation of the hybrid Wind-PV-ES power station is proposed for different frequency ranges based on the improved AGC control. After the primary frequency regulation action, the energy storage output is given priority control before wind and solar. When the energy storage active margin is insufficient, use the frequency regulation capacity of wind and photovoltaic power system to improve the primary frequency regulation capacity of the hybrid Wind-PV-ES power station. The control strategy proposed in this paper can improve the primary frequency regulation capability of renewable energy station. Finally, the paper verifies the effectiveness of the proposed control strategy through simulation.

articleTitle: A continuous commutation failure control strategy based on model predictive control
publicationTitle: Annual Meeting of CSEE Study Committee of HVDC and Power Electronics (HVDC 2023)
abstract: Prediction and control about commutation failure is the key problem for HVDC project. Most researches in this field focus on the short-circuit conditions in AC system. However, commutation failures were increasingly caused by the harmonics and inrush current in power system recently. In this paper, the influence mechanism of voltage waveform distortion on commutation process is analysed from two aspects: the commutation time-voltage area and zero crossing point of voltage waveform, a continuous control strategy for commutation failure caused by AC voltage distortion is proposed on the basis of model predictive control (MPC) method to cooperate with DC control. Firstly, the harmonic analysis of AC inverter bus is conducted by Least Square Method (LSM) in real time. Then a predictive model and a rolling optimization method are proposed based on commutation area theory to calculate the firing angle. And the feedback correction algorithm is used to improve the prediction accuracy. Finally, a simulation study was carried out on the two working conditions of superimposed harmonics on the inverter side and no-load closing transformer on the basis of PSCAD verify the proposed MPC strategy. The results show that MPC-based method can help to avoid multiple commutation failures caused by disturbance such as harmonics and inrush current, thereby to ensure the safe operation of power grid.

articleTitle: Calculation method of closed-loop current in distribution network based on the improved cumulant method
publicationTitle: Annual Meeting of CSEE Study Committee of HVDC and Power Electronics (HVDC 2023)
abstract: The closing interconnection switch for power supply operation can improve the reliability of the distribution network, but the closing loop blindly is harmful. At the same time, the access of distributed generation(DG) brings uncertainty to the closing loop of distribution network, which needs to be solved by probabilistic load flow calculation method. Therefore, this paper proposes a closed-loop current calculation method of distribution network based on the improved cumulant method. Firstly, the probability distribution model of load, wind and solar output is established and the cumulants of each order are calculated, and the closed-loop current calculation equation is established. Then, the wind and solar output range is divided into multiple sections, and the equations are linearized at each reference point, and the calculation error is reduced by improving cumulant method. Based on the closed-loop current cumulants and the series expansion method, the cumulative probability distribution characteristics of the closed-loop current are obtained. Finally, the IEEE 33 node system with DG is simulated. The results show that the proposed method can effectively calculate the closed-loop current of the first branch of the feeder, and the calculation time is significantly shortened compared with the Monte Carlo Simulation Method.

articleTitle: Starting optimization of optimal trigger angle for asynchronous motor with discrete variable frequency under large load
publicationTitle: Annual Meeting of CSEE Study Committee of HVDC and Power Electronics (HVDC 2023)
abstract: The traditional asynchronous motor starting method can not take into account the performance indexes of starting current, starting torque and starting time, which is difficult to meet the requirements of motor heavy load starting; while the discrete frequency conversion soft start has the characteristics of low starting current and high starting torque, a division frequency switching industrial frequency heavy load optimal starting program is proposed. The phase sequence analysis of discrete frequency conversion is carried out to determine the sequence of starting frequency bands, and the principle of selecting the triggering angle of division frequency is formulated at the same time. Different combinations of trigger angles obtained from the initial selection of each division frequency are compared and analyzed, and the optimal combinations of trigger angles for direct starting of heavy loads at division frequencies of 7, 4 and 3 are proposed. Combined with three kinds of industrial frequency heavy-duty starting mode and using the combination analysis method for selection, the proposed 4 division frequency 60° triggering angle switching industrial frequency current limiting soft start for the optimal program of frequency switching industrial frequency heavy-duty starting, effectively simplifying the starting control process, systematically optimizing the various sub-stages of the starting process, with great theoretical significance and practical value of the project.

articleTitle: Analysis to optimization strategy of critical energy storage configuration in different scenarios with abandonment rate of photovoltaic power
publicationTitle: Annual Meeting of CSEE Study Committee of HVDC and Power Electronics (HVDC 2023)
abstract: Configuration of energy storage equipment is an effective way to reduce the photovoltaic (PV) power waste However, the cost of energy storage equipment is high, and it will bring great economic significance to optimize the energy storage configuration, reduce the abandonment rate of PV power and meet the power consumption needs. Taken the cost of energy storage configuration and the electricity price in different range into consideration, this paper transforms the design issue of minimum energy storage configuration to a mathematical issue of finding the extreme value within the limit range, based on the precondition that the system does not transmit the power inversely. Based on the optimal design of energy storage configuration, CPLEX and YALMIP solvers have been adopted to verify the values of configuration that is less than, equal to and greater than the critical value of configuration of the energy storage respectively. The results show that the energy storage configuration equal to or higher than the critical configuration calculated by the mathematical model can effectively ensure that the abandonment rate of PV power is zero under the premise that the system does not transmit the power inversely. The energy storage configuration lower than the critical configuration will lead to PV power abandonment, demonstrating the correctness of the proposed calculation method.

articleTitle: Operating characteristics and artificial short circuit test of cascaded full bridge hybrid DC circuit breaker
publicationTitle: Annual Meeting of CSEE Study Committee of HVDC and Power Electronics (HVDC 2023)
abstract: As the first high-voltage DC circuit breaker topology to achieve engineering application, the cascaded full bridge hybrid DC circuit breaker has successfully cleared DC pole grounding faults in Zhoushan Five-terminal VSC-HVDC Transmission Project several times after being put into operation. The operation principle of the cascaded full bridge hybrid DC circuit breaker is analysed in this paper, a detailed analysis of the commutation process of the full bridge submodule during the circuit breaker breaking process is provided. The impact of stray inductance on the sub-module breaking process was analysed through test data. The branch commutation process of the cascaded full bridge DC circuit breaker is analysed during the breaking process. Finally, the artificial short circuit test result of cascaded full bridge high-voltage DC circuit breakers in the Zhoushan Five-terminal VSC-HVDC Transmission Project was analysed.
